title: NAGiD: Non-exhaustive Accessible Genizah Database
description: NAGiD is a JSON database of Cairo Genizah letters. It brings metadata and transcriptions from the Princeton Geniza Project, MiDRASH, the Cambridge Digital Library and the National Library of Israel together into one record per shelfmark, and adds AI-inferred dates. Each transcription is credited to its source edition. See the README for the schema, coverage and limitations.
